# Sloppy Joe's - The era of AI Signage

September 14, 2026

As I walk around my neighborhood in New York, each day I’m greeted with more and more signage that is clearly AI generated. The default style of ChatGPT signage is very standard - you can see how my Sloppy Joe version looks very similar to the ones spotted in the wild:

Some look better than others - but they share many tropes:

- Paint-stroke fonts, banners, and circles.

- Greebling , lots of little splats around key words

- Checkmarks, stars, and arrows galore

- A sort of bombastic eye-catching style that uses lots of colors

- Punchy three-phrase slogans or lists with little useless icons

- A made-up logo that is not found anywhere on the real store

The result is a sort of maximalist, garish sign that my brain has quickly learned to ignore. I recently wrote a bit about my feelings on AI generated art infesting our human world, so I won’t make a huge point of all this. These signs don’t matter much even when they’re human generated.
